close_reason: Bump checklist + parity summary line, commit 37065860
description:
## Question

Write down, as a reusable checklist, what bumping turnkey's pinned buck2 release takes: toolbox update, the pinned record (rev, protos hash, prelude version), prelude patches rebasing, the parity suite gate, every CI gate. Supersedes the checklist owed by turnkey-q7r; fold in what that upgrade actually took.

comments.text: Per turnkey-luk.8: the parity suite is a manual checklist step, and the bump commit must carry its summary line (scenarios matched, target count, buck2 release, platform). CI gate is tracked separately in turnkey-kxe.

Resolution: commit 37065860 (not pushed). docs/developer-manual/src/contributing/bumping-buck2.md, linked from SUMMARY, nix/patches/prelude/README.md and buck2-source.nix. The parity suite now prints the summary line bumps carry; ran on this stack: parity: 3/3 scenarios match on 30 targets (buck2 2026-09-14-6507dd15..., arm64-darwin).

title: Write the checklist for bumping turnkey's pinned buck2 release
